[EN] My goal is to study prion relics, but the Gutrends have made off with them.

I suspect the relics are still somewhere inside their cave. Will you retrieve them for me?
[ES] Mi objetivo es estudiar reliquias prion, pero los Gutrends se han apoderado de ellas.

Sospecho que las reliquias siguen en algún lugar dentro de su cueva. ¿Las recuperarás para mí?

[EN] Thank you. These should increase my knowledge of Saleron and the prion race.

You've been very helpful, .
[ES] Gracias. Estas deberían aumentar mi conocimiento sobre Saleron y la raza prion.

Has sido de gran ayuda, .

[EN] You were finding prion relics for me. Did you get them yet?
[ES] Estabas encontrando reliquias prion para mí. ¿Ya las conseguiste?
